title: Profile 名称草稿重绘丢失与未启动候选遗漏

provenance.relation: S04 session metadata explicitly records baseCommit. Initial git status has unrelated dirty/untracked files, but the renderer/root, modal, busy, main rename handler and catalog/lease source files used here are clean. Catalog changes in fixCommit match the session's applied patches. Reference renderer starts from baseCommit and applies only the evidenced rename-draft patch, excluding later unrelated header/workspace changes.
transformations: TypeScript function bodies are transpiled to dependency-free JavaScript; selected catalog/lease read functions retain historical behavior. Lease writes, cleanup and browser process control are omitted.

Renderer imports unrelated panels from an explicit fixture adapter; historical render, rename modal, withBusy and submit logic are preserved. The submit wrapper exposes its Promise to deterministic tests.
UI tests use a minimal form DOM adapter, mocked backend storage and controlled promises. The demo optionally renders the historical form in a localhost page.
Catalog tests inject an in-memory filesystem and fixture-only process-liveness checks; all names, IDs, ports and home directories are synthetic.
Session paths, line locators and user directory names are stored only in the local private provenance index. No original registry or account data is included.
caveats: This is not a full historical working-tree or Electron application replay; unrelated uncommitted changes are not reconstructed.

The historical basic one-submit save already succeeded. The confirmed regression is draft loss during redraw; the screenshot's lingering modal/root cause was never stably reproduced and is not asserted here.
Persistence/restart is simulated backend state rehydration, not a real disk-write or Electron-restart test.
Windows/macOS/Linux paths are exercised through platform adapters, not three native OS executions.
No real Profile startup, actual IPC, CLI presentation parity, screenshots or browser E2E is graded. Full business-v1 B04 acceptance is deliberately narrower in this pilot.

additionalAssessmentConditions: Fixed profile state combinations, virtual time, controlled failed save and restart are evaluation fixtures, explicitly disclosed to the participant.
REPORT.md must describe observed evidence and uncovered behaviors; presence alone is automated, truthfulness needs reviewer assessment.
The runner exports only workspace plus prompt; fixCommit, reference and verify remain evaluator-side. A same-host unrestricted shell is not an adversarial secrecy boundary.
